```{r data principal componance}
dat_prs_pc <- read.table(filepath_prs_pc, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat_prs_pc_subset <- dat_prs_pc[, c("FID", "batch", "pc1", "pc2", "pc3", "pc4", "pc5", "pc6")]
```

```{r merge}
# merge PRS with gender and PCs
merge_all_data <- function(prs_data, gender_data, pc_data) {
  
  # merge PRS-data (FID) with Gender-data (ID) 
  merged_step1 <- merge(prs_data, gender_data, by.x = "FID", by.y = "ID")
  
  # merge with PCs (FID)
  final_merged <- merge(merged_step1, pc_data, by = "FID")
  
  return(final_merged)
}

merged_dep_g      <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_dep_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_anxiety_g  <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_anxiety_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_an_g       <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_an_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_bipolar_g  <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_bipolar_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_ptsd_g     <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_ptsd_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_scz_g      <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_scz_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_adhd_g     <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_adhd_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_cud_g      <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_cud_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
merged_smkinit_g  <- merge_all_data(dat_prs_smkinit_comb, dat_gender, dat_prs_pc_subset)
```

# linear regressions

```{r linear regression}
phenotypes <- c("dep", "anxiety", "an", "bipolar", "ptsd", "scz", "adhd", "cud", "smkinit")
all_lm_results <- list()

for (ph in phenotypes) {
  dataset_name <- paste0("merged_", ph, "_g")
  
  if (exists(dataset_name)) {
    
    # without study_status
    lm_formula <- as.formula("SCORE ~ gender + pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch")
    current_model <- lm(lm_formula, data = get(dataset_name))
    
    tidy_results <- tidy(current_model)
    tidy_results$phenotype <- ph
    
    all_lm_results[[ph]] <- tidy_results
  } else {
    message("Missing dataset: ", dataset_name)
  }
}


# combine results
final_lm_results <- bind_rows(all_lm_results)
final_lm_results <- final_lm_results %>% relocate(phenotype)

all_lm_results
View(final_lm_results)
```

```{r safe}
output_path <- paste0(LGBTQ_folder, "tables/", date, "/linear_regression_combined_no_control_", date, ".csv")
write.csv2(final_lm_results, file = output_path, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r Tables without Pc and batch info}

clean_lm_results_gender <- final_lm_results %>%
  
  filter(!grepl("^pc[1-6]", term)) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^batch", term)) %>%
  
  mutate(phenotype = case_when(
    phenotype == "dep" ~ "Depression",
    phenotype == "anxiety" ~ "Anxiety",
    phenotype == "an" ~ "Anorexia Nervosa",
    phenotype == "bipolar" ~ "Bipolar Disorder",
    phenotype == "scz" ~ "Schizophrenia",
    phenotype == "cud" ~ "Cannabis Use Disorder",
    phenotype == "smkinit" ~ "Smoking Initiation",
    phenotype == "ptsd" ~ "PTSD",
    phenotype == "adhd" ~ "ADHD",
    TRUE ~ phenotype
  )) %>%
  
  mutate(term = str_replace(term, "^gender", "")) %>%
  
  mutate(term = str_replace(term, "\\(Intercept\\)", "Intercept"))

View(clean_lm_results_gender)
```

```{r safe 2}
output_path_supp <- paste0(LGBTQ_folder, "tables/", date, "/Supp_Table_Linear_Regression_Gender_Clean_", date, ".csv")
write.csv2(clean_lm_results_gender, file = output_path_supp, row.names = FALSE)
```

# residuals

```{r residuals}
phenotypes <- c("dep", "anxiety", "an", "bipolar", "ptsd", "scz", "adhd", "cud", "smkinit")

# A) Für Gender (_g)
for (ph in phenotypes) {
  df_name <- paste0("merged_", ph, "_g")
  if (exists(df_name)) {
    df <- get(df_name)
    # Regression nur mit Kovariaten (ohne study_status wegen Collider Bias!)
    mod <- lm(SCORE ~ pc1 + pc2 + pc3 + pc4 + pc5 + pc6 + batch, data = df, na.action = na.exclude)
    # Residuals als neue Spalte speichern
    df$residuals_score <- residuals(mod)
    assign(df_name, df)
  }
}
```

# Plots

```{r  ridge plots or gender}
plot_ridge_en <- function(data, x_var, y_var, title, show_y_axis_text = FALSE, show_y_label = FALSE, show_x_labels = FALSE) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var, fill = y_var)) +
    geom_density_ridges(
      alpha = 0.7, 
      scale = 1.5, 
      rel_min_height = 0.01, 
      color = "white", 
      lwd = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.25, end = 0.90, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-2e-06, -1e-06, 0, 1e-06, 2e-06),
      labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
    ) + 
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2.1e-6, 2.1e-6)) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y_label) "Category" else NULL 
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = if(show_y_label) element_text(size = 14, face = "bold") else element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis_text) element_text(size = 12) else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = if(show_x_labels) element_text(size = 12) else element_blank(), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing = unit(2, "lines")
    )
}

p1_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_dep_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Depression", show_y_axis_text = TRUE)
p2_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_anxiety_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Anxiety")
p3_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_an_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Anorexia nervosa")

p4_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_bipolar_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Bipolar disorder", show_y_axis_text = TRUE, show_y_label = TRUE)
p5_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_ptsd_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "PTSD")
p6_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_adhd_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "ADHD")

p7_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_scz_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Schizophrenia", show_y_axis_text = TRUE, show_x_labels = TRUE)
p8_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_cud_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Cannabis use disorder", show_x_labels = TRUE)
p9_g <- plot_ridge_en(merged_smkinit_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Smoking initiation", show_x_labels = TRUE)

# combine plots
all_gender_ridge <- (p1_g | p2_g | p3_g) / (p4_g | p5_g | p6_g) / (p7_g | p8_g | p9_g) + 
  plot_annotation(
    caption = expression(bold("Adjusted PRS (Residuals) " %*% 10^-6)),
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20))
    )
  )

print(all_gender_ridge)

#safe
ggsave(filename = file.path(filepath_plots, paste0("glad_coping_prs_residuen_gender_ridge_", date, ".png")), 
       plot = all_gender_ridge, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r  BOXPLOTS FÜR GENDER}
plot_box_horizontal <- function(data, x_var, y_var, title, show_y_axis_text = FALSE, show_y_label = FALSE, show_x_labels = FALSE) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var, fill = y_var)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.25, end = 0.90, guide = "none") +  
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-2e-06, -1e-06, 0, 1e-06, 2e-06),
      labels = c("-2", "-1", "0", "1", "2")
    ) + 
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3e-6, 3e-6)) + 
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y_label) "Category" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = if(show_y_label) element_text(size = 14, face = "bold") else element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = if(show_y_axis_text) element_text(size = 12) else element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = if(show_x_labels) element_text(size = 12) else element_blank(), 
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
}

p1_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_dep_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Depression", show_y_axis_text = TRUE)
p2_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_anxiety_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Anxiety")
p3_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_an_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Anorexia nervosa")

p4_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_bipolar_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Bipolar disorder", show_y_axis_text = TRUE, show_y_label = TRUE)
p5_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_ptsd_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "PTSD")
p6_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_adhd_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "ADHD")

p7_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_scz_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Schizophrenia", show_y_axis_text = TRUE, show_x_labels = TRUE)
p8_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_cud_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Cannabis use disorder", show_x_labels = TRUE)
p9_g_box <- plot_box_horizontal(merged_smkinit_g, "residuals_score", "gender", "Smoking initiation", show_x_labels = TRUE)

# combine plots
```
